result.topic_en: Algebraic calculations with quadratic relations among squared quantities p, q, r, parametrized by λ, μ, σ, leading to linear relations among square roots of the form √12 + √34 + √56 + √78 = 0, apparently connected with theta-function relations.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{1-\mu}(p^2-q^2) - \frac{1}{1-\nu}(p^2-r^2)$ \quad $\frac{1}{1-\mu}-1 = \frac{\mu}{1-\mu}$
$= \frac{\nu}{1-\nu}(p'^2-q'^2) - \frac{\mu}{1-\mu}(p'^2-r'^2)$
$(m-n)p^2 - mq^2 + nr^2 = (n-m)p'^2 - (n-1)q'^2 + (m-1)r'^2$
[-$q(\alpha+\beta)^2+(\alpha-\beta)^2 r^2 =$-]
$mq^2 - nr^2 + (n-1)q'^2 - (m-1)r'^2 = (m-n)(p^2+p'^2)$
$\alpha^2 \quad \beta^2 \quad \gamma^2 \quad \delta^2$
$\alpha^2-\beta^2+\gamma^2-\delta^2=0$ \quad $\alpha+\beta = \sigma(\delta+\gamma) = \lambda$
$\alpha-\beta = \frac{1}{\sigma}(\delta-\gamma) = \varrho$
[-$\alpha+\beta i = \sigma(\gamma+\delta i)$-]
[-$\alpha-\beta i = \frac{1}{\sigma}(\gamma-\delta i)$-] \quad [-$2\alpha = (\sigma+\frac{1}{\sigma})\delta + (\sigma-\frac{1}{\sigma})\gamma$-]
[-$\alpha=\sigma$-] \quad [-$2\beta = (\sigma+\frac{1}{\sigma})\delta + (\sigma+\frac{1}{\sigma})\gamma$-]
$2\alpha = \lambda+\varrho$ \quad $\alpha = \lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda}$ \quad $(\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda})q^2 \cdots = 4p^2+p'^2$
$2\beta = \lambda-\varrho$ \quad $\beta = \lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda}$
$2\gamma = \frac{\lambda}{\sigma} - \sigma\varrho$ \quad [-$\gamma = \mu-\frac{1}{\mu}$-] $\gamma = \mu-\frac{1}{\mu}$
$2\delta = \frac{\lambda}{\sigma}+\sigma\varrho$ \quad $\delta = \mu+\frac{1}{\mu}$
$(q+r)(\nu\lambda+\frac{1}{\nu\lambda}) + (q-r)(\frac{\lambda}{\nu}+\frac{\nu}{\lambda}) + (q'+r')(\mu\varrho+\frac{1}{\mu\varrho}) + (r'-q')(\frac{\varrho}{\mu}+\frac{\mu}{\varrho}) = 0$
$(q+r)\nu\lambda + (q-r)\frac{\nu}{\lambda} + (q'+r')\mu\varrho + (r'-q')\frac{\varrho}{\mu} = 2(p+p'i)\sigma$[?]
$(q+r)\frac{1}{\nu\lambda} + (q-r)\frac{\nu}{\lambda} + (q'+r')\frac{1}{\mu\varrho} + (r'-q')\frac{\mu}{\varrho} = -2(p-p'i)\frac{1}{\sigma}$
$(q'+r')(\mu\varrho-\frac{1}{\mu\varrho}) + (r'-q')(\frac{\varrho}{\mu}-\frac{\mu}{\varrho}) = 2p(\sigma-\frac{1}{\sigma}) + 2p'i(\sigma+\frac{1}{\sigma})$
$(q+r)(\nu\lambda-\frac{1}{\nu\lambda}) + (q-r)(\frac{\lambda}{\nu}-\frac{\nu}{\lambda}) = 2p(\sigma+\frac{1}{\sigma}) + 2p'i(\sigma-\frac{1}{\sigma})$
$\xi_1^2 \quad \xi_2^2 \quad \xi_3^2$
$1-\frac{1}{n} = \left(\frac{\mu-\frac{1}{\mu}}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda}}\right)^2$
$1-\frac{1}{m} = \left(\frac{\mu+\frac{1}{\mu}}{\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda}}\right)^2$
$\xi_1+\xi_2 = \lambda(\xi_3+\xi_4)$
$\lambda(\xi_1-\xi_2) = (\xi_3-\xi_4)$
$\left((q+r)\lambda+\frac{q-r}{\lambda}\right)\left((q-r)\lambda+\frac{q+r}{\lambda}\right) - \left((r'+q')\mu+\frac{r'-q'}{\mu}\right)\left((r'-q')\mu+\frac{r'+q'}{\mu}\right) = 4(p^2+p'^2)$
[-$(1-2)\nu\lambda + (3-4)\frac{\nu}{\lambda} + \frac{(1-2)}{\nu\lambda} + (3-4)\frac{\lambda}{\nu}$-] \quad $\left((1-2)\lambda+\frac{4-3}{\lambda}\right)\left((4-3)\lambda+\frac{1-2}{\lambda}\right) - (1-3+2-4)^2$
$\sqrt{12}+\sqrt{34}+\sqrt{56}+\sqrt{78}=0$ \quad $\left((1-2)\lambda^2+\frac{4-3}{\lambda^2}\right)x^2 + 2xy(1-3+2-4) + \left((4-3)\lambda^2+\frac{1-2}{\lambda^2}\right)y^2$
$(\mu+\frac{1}{\mu})(\sqrt{13}+\sqrt{24}) + (\lambda+\frac{1}{\lambda})(\sqrt{57}+\sqrt{68}) = 0$
$(\mu-\frac{1}{\mu})(\sqrt{14}+\sqrt{23}) + (\lambda-\frac{1}{\lambda})(\sqrt{58}+\sqrt{67}) = 0$ \quad $1(\lambda x+\frac{y}{\lambda})^2 - 2(\lambda x-\frac{y}{\lambda})^2 - 3(\frac{x}{\lambda}+\lambda y)^2 + 4(\frac{x}{\lambda}-\lambda y)^2$

methods.what: Quadratic relation among squares p,q,r,p',q',r' with parameters m,n
Parametrization of a vanishing alternating sum of four squares via λ, ϱ, σ
Expression of moduli m, n in terms of parameters λ, μ
Linear relations among ξ's via λ
Linear relations among square roots of products (eight-term relations)
Relation with coefficients μ±1/μ, λ±1/λ among square roots
Quadratic form in x,y as combination of squares of linear forms
